steps: A saved exact generated controller references a noninitial clip UUID owned only by another scene. GUI Plan rejects before any tool or generated output, points at the exact BOM/CRLF/UTF-16 JSON value and preserves every author byte.

Chinese, English and Japanese problem labels fit 390px. Clicking the problem selects exactly the missing clip JSON value despite BOM/CRLF and an earlier astral character. Ordinary editor Save changes only that behavior source and preserves its original encoding/newlines.

After explicit repair, GUI Plan, Build and actual Godot headless Run succeed. Only the initial idle select/play executes; the noninitial state reference was nevertheless checked before build. Existing protocol 10 remains unchanged and subsequent tasks preserve all author bytes.
